title: Plate Filling Sample in AB 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol transfers sample from [NEST 96-Well Plates](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-0-1-ml-96-well-pcr-plate-full-skirt) to [Applied Biosystems MicroAmp 384-well plates](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4343370#/4343370) with mastermix. **Update**: this protocol has been updated to accommodate the SSI 384-well plate as well. The protocol can fill one or two, 384-well plates. The [P20 Single-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) will aspirate 5µL from each well of the [NEST 96-Well Plates](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-0-1-ml-96-well-pcr-plate-full-skirt) and dispense 2.5µL into two wells of the (A1 --> A1/B1; B1 --> C1/D1; etc.) **Update (10/22/20):** The protocol will now aspirate 10µL and dispense 5µL into two wells. **Update (11/2/20):** The protocol will now aspirate 20µL and dispense 10µL into two wells. Additionally, the option to use the p300-multi pipette has been added. **Updated (11/12/20):** A new parameter has been added that allows the user to input the volume (in µL) of sample that should be transferred. The pipette will aspirate 2x the volume and dispense into two wells. --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons P20 Single-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [Opentrons 20µL Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [Applied Biosystems MicroAmp 384-Well Plate](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4343370#/4343370) or SSI 384-Well Plate with mastermix * [NEST 96-Well Plates
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the Opentrons website or repository.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set sample transfer volume
steps.instruction: In the protocol parameters, enter the desired sample volume (µL) to transfer from each NEST 96‑well source well; the robot will aspirate twice this volume and dispense half into each of two adjacent 384‑well destination wells. For reference, earlier versions used 5 µL aspirate/2.5 µL dispense, then 10 µL aspirate/5 µL dispense, and later 20 µL aspirate/10 µL dispense.

steps.title: Select pipette type
steps.instruction: Choose either the P20 single‑channel pipette (for volumes up to 20 µL) or the P300 multi‑channel pipette (for larger volumes) in the protocol settings.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the NEST 96‑well source plate, one or two Applied Biosystems MicroAmp or SSI 384‑well destination plates (containing mastermix), the appropriate tip rack (20 µL tips for P20 or 300 µL tips for P300), and the selected pipette on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run calibration for the deck layout, tip rack, source plate, destination plate(s), and the selected pipette, following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the transfer; the robot will aspirate the specified volume from each 96‑well well and dispense half into two 384‑well wells (e.g., A1 → A1/B1, B1 → C1/D1, etc.).
